therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: nuclear receptor agonism and enzyme inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: insulin sensitization and LDL cholesterol reduction
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Median percent change from baseline to Week 6 in LDL-c in FDC vs RSG monotherapy

results.effect_size: -37.2% difference in LDL-c (FDC vs RSG monotherapy, 95% CI: -41.2 to -32.9)
results.target_engagement_evidence: LDL-c reduction of ~39.9% in FDC groups vs +5.4% in RSG monotherapy; HbA1c reduction of -0.83 in FDC vs -0.01 in SIMV monotherapy
biomarker_changes: FDC groups: median LDL-c change -39.9% vs RSG monotherapy +5.4%
FDC groups: mean HbA1c change -0.83 vs SIMV monotherapy -0.01
FDC 8/40 mg: FPG change -2.10 mmol/L; FDC 8/80 mg: -1.90 mmol/L
SIMV monotherapy: FPG change +0.37 to +0.43 mmol/L
Body weight increase with RSG-containing arms (up to +2.2 kg with RSG 8 mg at Week 16)
SIMV monotherapy associated with slight weight decrease (-0.5 to -1.5 kg at Week 16)
subgroup_findings: FDC groups: 148 participants achieved LDL<100 mg/dL vs 20 in RSG monotherapy (OR 36.32, p<0.0001)
FDC groups: 108 participants achieved HbA1c<7% or reduction>=0.7% vs 26 in SIMV monotherapy (OR 4.05, p<0.0001)
FDC groups: 96 participants achieved FPG<126 mg/dL or reduction>=30 mg/dL vs 22 in SIMV monotherapy (OR 3.93, p<0.0001)
Higher dose FDC 8/80 mg showed greatest LDL-c reduction (-44.4%)
safety_signals: Pneumonia reported in 2 participants in RSG 8 mg arm
Myocardial infarction in 1 participant in FDC RSG/SIMV 8/40 mg arm
Abscess in 1 participant in FDC RSG/SIMV 8/80 mg arm
Femur fracture in 1 participant in RSG 8 mg arm
Low hemoglobin observed in FDC 8/80 mg (4 participants) and SIMV 80 mg (3 participants)
Elevated creatine kinase in 1 participant each in FDC 4/40 mg and RSG 4 mg
Elevated GGT in SIMV 40 mg (3 participants)
Weight gain observed with RSG-containing arms

dose_info.dose: RSG 4 mg or 8 mg; SIMV 40 mg or 80 mg; FDC RSG/SIMV 4/40, 4/80, 8/40, or 8/80 mg

context.comparator: RSG monotherapy (for LDL-c primary endpoint); SIMV monotherapy (for HbA1c secondary endpoint)
